findings.title: FIXTURE json-equals receipt can change OBSERVED evidence backed by a LIVE snapshot
findings.impact: A deterministic fixture that merely repeats its expected JSON can write an authoritative judgement onto OBSERVED Evidence; no source-semantic verification is performed. The same leak applies to VERIFIED, CONTRADICTED and UNAVAILABLE.
findings.reproduction: Write/read a local temporary source stating 2 + 2 = 4; use normal HTTP upload/seal and Evidence APIs to create OBSERVED/LOCAL Evidence claiming source states 2 + 2 = 5 with an OBSERVED/LIVE SOURCE_SNAPSHOT; accept a separate FIXTURE task carrying the chosen judgement; submit its exact receipt checks to verifyEvidence. All three statuses return 200 and persist revision 2. Scope reproduction performs no direct DB mutation.
findings.expected: In the currently implemented fixture-only lane, reject an OBSERVED target or LIVE snapshot without mutating Evidence.
findings.repair: Enforce SIMULATED Evidence and SIMULATED/FIXTURE SOURCE_SNAPSHOT before applying any judgement. Add all-three-status fail-closed coverage for OBSERVED/LIVE targets. Future live verification needs its own qualified runtime/acceptance and source-semantic verification path.

passed_boundaries: Missing Idempotency-Key / If-Match rejected 428; changed requested judgement/checks rejected 422.
Exact idempotency replay returns the same response and ETag; new-key reuse rejected 409.

Evidence revision bump makes the historical task current-binding stale while the new Evidence remains effective; a downstream task consuming the new version passes acceptance without recursive invalidation.
Policy change, run epoch rotation, unsettled run, removed verifier role and revoked receipt-verifier grant rejected without Evidence mutation.
Context seal mutation rejected by immutable DB trigger; changed context prerequisite rejected as stale.
Old Evidence revision rejected 412; mutation of sealed snapshot bytes rejected by DB.
Source/executor aliases holding VERIFIER roles rejected 403 by authority-root independence check.
limitations: No production/provider/service configuration or source edits by verifier.
LIVE is target snapshot metadata of an actual local temporary-file read; all probe execution and claims remain synthetic FIXTURE evidence. No provider accuracy is claimed.
